run_crystal_evaluation: run the evaluation script to compute validity, coverage, novelty, and diversity metrics for generated crystals
create_crystal_from_cif: create a Crystal object from a CIF string using cif_str_to_crystal
compute_coverage_metrics: compute coverage recall and precision metrics by comparing generated crystals against ground truth crystals
compute_novelty_metrics: compute structural and compositional novelty metrics for generated crystals against ground truth
evaluate_crystal_validity: evaluate crystal validity using smact chemical validity and structural distance checks
